You may share and adapt it for any purpose, including commercially, as long as you give credit. When you reuse it, for example in course slides, a worksheet or another quiz, please write:

The N, s<sub>N</sub> and E values themselves are measurements published by others and collected in Mayr's Database of Reactivity Parameters (LMU München). This license does not cover them; please cite the original papers named on each card when you use the values.
